integrity: The normal form is proved by the cotangent map, branch-length preservation, and branchwise annihilators. The finite-field formula is checked by exhaustive enumeration in the stated small cases. Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The formula applies to the stated commutative coordinate-cross quotient, not arbitrary monomial ideals or noncommutative products.
General characteristic-zero monomial-algebra automorphism theory may cover the characteristic-zero specialization.
Older positive-characteristic work on fiber products or truncated coordinate axes may contain an equivalent mixed-length result; searches did not locate one.
Finite-field enumeration verifies only the listed small cases; the universal claim rests on the proof.
title: Mixed-length truncated coordinate crosses: automorphisms and finite-field order
